subject: NeonCloud / Redwood: LlamaIndex adapter QC, telemetry & MPA coordination
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex@neoncloud.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NeonCloud / Redwood: LlamaIndex adapter QA & telemetry contract

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team's excited about a lightweight LlamaIndex adapter for NeonCloud customers. Before we kick off engineering work we need two things squared away on our side:

1) A concrete acceptance/QA checklist so our SREs can validate the adapter in our sandbox (what success looks like: prefix caching disabled scenarios, max sequence regression, memory/KV behavior)
2) The telemetry schema and contract (what fields you will emit, sampling policy, PII handling) so our compliance team can sign off.

Can you share those artifacts? Also curious if you have a standard mutual action plan (MAP/MPA) template or preferred DocuSign flow — our legal team will want to send a short set of redlines.

Proposed timeline from NeonCloud: engineering sandbox validation week of May 24 — can Redwood commit a point of contact to coordinate testing and one tech owner for acceptance?

Thanks — happy to sync on a 30m call if easier.

— Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Integrations, NeonCloud
alex@neoncloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@neoncloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NeonCloud / Redwood: LlamaIndex adapter QA & telemetry contract

Hi Alex — thanks, this is great context.

We can absolutely provide both the QA acceptance checklist and the telemetry contract. Attaching two artifacts to start: 1) llamaindex-adapter-spec-v1.pdf (implementation expectations + integration test vectors) and 2) telemetry-schema-v1.csv (field list + sampling guidance).

Summary of what Redwood will commit to for the sandbox validation:
- Redwood tech owner: karthik_iyer (cc'd) will be point for infra/runbook and will join smoke tests.
- Acceptance criteria (high level):
  * Adapter passes canonical LlamaIndex read/write vectors and memory/KV sanity checks
  * End-to-end latency within agreed SLO (p95 target documented in spec)
  * Telemetry conforms to supplied schema with no PII fields and sampling <= 0.1% by default
- Test harness: we will publish a small pytest suite that NeonCloud can run against the sandbox endpoint.

Action items:
- Alex: confirm you can share NeonCloud's sandbox credentials and the team that will run the pytest suite (names/emails)
- Vanessa / Marissa: can you review commercial/acceptance side? We expect a short MPA addressing support scope and credits for joint sandbox runs.
- Legal: if NeonCloud sends redlines we can loop Redwood Legal via Vanessa.

Proposed meeting: Tue May 10, 10:00–10:30 PT to walk checklist and agree on the MAP scope. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: llamaindex-adapter-spec-v1.pdf, telemetry-schema-v1.csv

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Integration Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: NeonCloud / Redwood: LlamaIndex adapter QA & telemetry contract

Hi Alex — looping in commercial and PM so we can lock terms quickly.

Quick commercial notes for context (high level):
- Sandbox credits: Redwood can provide up to 2 weeks of developer credits for onboarding and acceptance runs (we'll consume those against a joint test project).
- Technical acceptance will be led by Marissa (cc'd) — Marissa, please coordinate the pytest schedule and report format (pass/fail plus two reproducible failures max for escalation).
- MPA: NeonCloud legal redlines are expected; please send the redlines to me and cc olga. We'll aim for a 3-business-day turnaround for a narrow adapter MPA.

Marissa, can you confirm you can take point on the test harness run windows during week of May 24? Karthik, please confirm your availability for a smoke test on May 25 (30–45 minutes).

Thanks — small ask from NeonCloud and happy to prioritize.

- I'll have our SREs (Samir and Priya) request sandbox creds by EOD May 6 and I'll share names.
- Uploading initial MSA redlines now (attached: neoncloud_initial_redlines.pdf). Our legal team will follow with a tracked doc (legal@neoncloud.com).
